notes: The detector now abstains instead of guessing. When it is essentially tied between human and AI, it shows “Too close to call” with no verdict rather than flipping a coin. On held-out data those coin-flip calls were wrong about half the time; holding them back cut the false-flag rate on human writing from 4.8% to about 4.3%.

Borderline results are the honest ones now: Mixed or “Too close to call” means the model genuinely cannot tell — read the writing yourself. A score is a signal to review, never proof of who wrote something.
